Geoffrey’a Hartmana, Marianne Hirsch, Michaela Rothberga i Barbary Skargi.

The presented article focuses on analysis of one-man show Remember This by Clark Young and Derek Goldman, using Memory Studies perspective. The authoress researches artistic creation of the main character (Jan Karski, Polish emissary during the Second World War, portrayed on stage by David Strathairn) and play’s scenography, the meaning of memory as a crucial motif in the drama, and explores the position of Young and Goldman work both as a Holocaust testimony and within a broader concept of multidirectional memory. The article references, among others, Geoffrey Hartman, Marianne Hirsch, Michael Rothberg and Barbara Skarga.

Dotychczas nie było wiadomo skąd pochodził i gdzie działał przed przybyciem do Częstochowy. results.title: The theory of the aesthetic situation of Maria Gołaszewska (1926-2015) and feminist interventions in philosophy

abstracts.content: Maria Gołaszewska (1926-2015) was a Polish philosopher associated throughout her life with Poland’s oldest academic institution, the Jagiellonian University in Cracow. She was a student of the phenomenologist Roman Ingarden, himself a student of Edmund Husserl. During the post-war and communist years in Poland, Gołaszewska conducted research focusing on issues related to art and aesthetics. She created her own conception of empirically and anthropologically oriented aesthetics, which I believe is a prime example of a theory that accounts for the perspective of gender, and which in this sense should be acknowledged as having anticipated the main postulates of contemporary feminist philosophy. In the article I present Gołaszewska’s philosophy as a cognitively valuable response to the search of feminist aesthetics for a suitable description of women’s experiences related to art and aesthetic perception. In accordance with this aim, I discuss Gołaszewska’s theory of the aesthetic situation, a framework within which she proposed solutions similar to feminist standpoint theories. These theories were developed chiefly on the basis of the feminist philosophy and feminist epistemology (Elizabeth Anderson, Donna Haraway, Sandra Harding, Elizabeth Potter). In recent years they have also found creative applications in feminist aesthetics (Anne Eaton).

results.title: Az ezerarcú szerelem a lengyel és magyar romantikában : választott szerzők és művek alapján

abstracts.content: The article analyses the image of broadly understood love - with particular emphasis on erotic and family love - in selected works of Polish and Hungarian romantics against the background of their private lives. The authors whose works (usually poems) were selected are János Arany (1817-1882), Aleksander Fredro (1793-1876), Maurycy Jókai (1825-1904), Zygmunt Krasiński (1812–1859), Adam Mickiewicz (1798-1855), Cyprian Kamil Norwid (1821-1883), Sándor Petőfi (1823-1849), Juliusz Słowacki 1809-1849) and Mihály Vörösmarty (1800-1855). Polish romantic literature is more transcendent than Hungarian one, which is clearly visible, among others, based on ballads about matters of tragic love. An original and rare feature of Hungarian poetry is the work devoted to the family - parents, wife, children, friends, and his children. It is significant that in the era of Romanticism in our national literatures, the time has not yet come for women’s works, so when it comes to depicting love, in both literatures we mean “men’s” literature. The image of love - or its loss - was idealized by all authors, or, in some ballads, demonized. In their private lives, Polish authors were influenced and influenced by romantic stereotypes from other cultures to a greater extent than their Hungarian colleagues

results.title: Doświadczenie opętania w pismach autobiograficznych ojca Josepha Surina (1600-1665)

abstracts.content:
Doświadczenie opętania w pismach autobiograficznych ojca Josepha Surina (1600-1665) 
Ojciec Joseph Surin, mistyk i egzorcysta, po sprawowaniu posługi duchowej wobec przeoryszy z Loudun sam przez 20 lat doświadczał opętania. Jego przypadek, wielokrotnie badany i studiowany przez teologów, znawców życia duchowego, psychiatrów – zarówno agnostyków jak i wierzących, w Polsce doczekał się jednego tylko opracowania w monografii Leszka Kołakowskiego z roku 1965. Studium to, mimo swej erudycyjności, wymaga pewnych dopowiedzeń opartych o najnowsze rozpoznania z zakresu teologii życia duchowego oraz psychologii. Rewizji wymaga także czysto racjonalistyczne, a przez to nieco redukujące podejście filozofa do doświadczeń ojca Surina oraz dość ironiczny ton, w jakim są one analizowane. Celem artykułu jest, po pierwsze, usytuowanie analiz opętania zawartych w pismach ojca Surina na tle tradycji chrześcijańskiej; następnie zbadanie w jaki sposób jezuita interpretuje własne doświadczenie obsesji demonicznej, odróżniając je konsekwentnie od opętania, które dotknęło przeoryszę z Loudun; wreszcie skonfrontowanie wyłożonej przez niego metafizycznej interpretacji własnych przeżyć duchowych z aktualnymi koncepcjami psychologicznymi na temat tzw. dysocjacyjnych zaburzeń osobowości.

The Experience of Possession in the Autobiographical Writings of Father Joseph Surin (1600-1665) 
Father Joseph Surin, a mystic and exorcist, experienced possession himself for 20 years after exercising spiritual ministry to the Prioress of Loudun. His case has been repeatedly researched and studied by theologians, experts in the spiritual life, psychiatrists, both agnostics and believers, yet in Poland it has been dealt with only by Leszek Kołakowski in his monograph of 1965. His study, despite its erudition, requires certain additions based on the latest findings in theology and psychology. The philosopher's purely rationalist and therefore somewhat reductive approach to Father Surin's experiences and the rather ironic tone of the analysis also require revision. The aim of this article is, firstly, to situate the analyses of possession contained in Father Surin's writings against the background of the Christian tradition; then to examine how he interprets his own experience of demonic obsession, consistently distinguishing it from the possession that afflicted the Prioress of Loudun; and finally to confront his own metaphysical interpretation of his spiritual experiences with current psychological concepts on so-called dissociative personality disorders.

The chapter deals with the issue of the constitutional, theoretical and socially adequate model of local community response to the nuisances accompanying it at the micro level. The experience of British regulation of the so-called Anti Social Behavior Order and then Civil Injunctions shows an interesting perspective of increasing the decision-making power of communities to regulate orders and prohibitions, which are then accompanied by a specific type of sanctions. Arguments are presented for and against the introduction of such solutions for enhancing citizen agency in the organization of life at the local level. What has been successful and what is questionable? To what extent would the current Polish constitutional solutions allow to make the rigid system of centralized response to offenses more flexible?

results.title: "DEMOKRACIJA" w języku chorwackim : językowy obraz konceptu

abstracts.content:
Artykuł stanowi rekonstrukcję językowego obrazu DEMOKRACJI
w języku chorwackim na podstawie danych systemowych, ankietowych
i tekstowych. Ich analiza wykazała, że obraz ten nie jest jednorodny. O ile
zasadniczą część defnicji podzielają, przynajmniej implicite, wszystkie
źródła (władza wszystkich obywateli lub władza ludu), to dodatkowe
cechy defnicyjne podawane są rozmaicie. Zwłaszcza w tekstach często
można spotkać stwierdzenia dotyczące chorwackiej demokracji jako dopiero rozwijającej się w kierunku modelu zachodniego. Istotny jest więc
tu aspekt dynamiczny: bądź w opozycji do przeszłości (profl centroprawicowy), bądź w kierunku demokracji liberalnej (profl socjalliberalny).
Badania ankietowe (profl codzienny) potwierdziły znaczne niezadowolenie z funkcjonowania demokracji przy jednoczesnym uznawaniu jej za
istotną wartość kulturową, która powinna mieć solidne zakorzenienie
społeczne.

The article presents a reconstruction of the linguistic picture of DEMOCRACY in
the Croatian language, basing on systemic, survey and textual data. Their analysis
indicates that this picture is not homogeneous. While the core defnition is, at least
implicitly, shared by all the sources (rule of all citizens or the people’s rule), the
additional defnitional features are manifested in a more diverse way. Especially in
texts, one can encounter statements about Croatian democracy as still developing
towards the Western model. Therefore, a dynamic aspect is important here: either
in opposition against the past (centre-right profle), or towards liberal democracy
(social-liberal profle). The survey data (everyday profle) reveal signifcant dissatisfaction with the functioning of democracy, but at the same time its acceptance as an
important cultural value which should be socially rooted.

results.title: The relationship between the geographical location of Venezuelan migrants and refugees and their integration into the host society : the case of Metropolitan Lima

abstracts.content: In recent years, due to the massive exodus of the Venezuelan population, many Latin American countries have experienced new and complex realities (unhcr, 2020). The crisis related to the COVID-19 pandemic further increased existing challenges, exposing many systemic problems in the developing countries of the region and affecting mainly the most vulnerable, including migrants. Of the 7.13 million people who left Venezuela, 5.99 million have settled in the region (r4v, 2022), mainly due to geographic proximity and cultural and language similarities. In Peru, where approximately 1.5 million Venezuelans live, this extensive migratory movement has changed the socioeconomic dynamics and territorial development processes. More than 1 million have settled in Metropolitan Lima, representing 10% of the inhabitants of the Peruvian capital (sela, 2022), and generating a significant change in the demographic and labour market composition. The following study is cross-sectional and focusses on documents and research on the spatial integration of the Venezuelan population in Metropolitan Lima, characterising its living conditions, vulnerabilities and challenges for integration into the host society, and emphasising the good practises of local governments. Taking into account the territorial distribution of the Venezuelan population in the Peruvian capital, there is a marked inclination towards the selection of districts located in semi-peripheral areas, and not peripheral ones, as they tend to possess an adequate infrastructure and facilitate access to employment and public services. Given that the Venezuelan population chooses the geographical proximity of central districts, we could expect that this will accelerate their integration into the host society. The results also highlight the importance of implementing inclusive policies that consider the migratory phenomenon as part of the Sustainable development process, which can generate positive collateral effects for migrants and the host society.

Skonfrontowanie filozoficzno-socjologicznych diagnoz Baumana z problemem wysferzenia i stopniowego rozmywania się chłopskich tożsamości zobrazowanych na przykładzie utworów: "Nagi sad" Wiesława Myśliwskiego, "Opowieści galicyjskie" Andrzeja Stasiuka oraz "Prawiek i inne czasy" Olgi Tokarczuk pozwalają na prześledzenie ewolucji zjawiska zanikania kulturowych prowincji oraz unaoczniają proces kształtowania się zdegenerowanych post-chłopskich kreacji. Przejście od chłopskości przez ludowość i nową plebejskość do peryferyjnej po-wiejskości, a więc od wykorzenienia przez wydziedziczenie do wygnania, rozlicza dziedzictwo minionej kultury i ukazuje chłopskiego potomka jako człowieka z pogranicza kultur i środowisk, który staje się nowym obcym ponowoczesnej rzeczywistości.

The article discusses changes in the portrayal of peasant identity and forms of individual and communal isolation in the literature of the second half and the end of the 20th century, linked to the decline of the village and its culture. The analysis is based on the perspective of worldview transformations in postmodern reality. Confronting Bauman's philosophical-sociological diagnoses with the issue of the dispersion and gradual fading of peasant identities illustrates the evolution of the phenomenon of vanishing cultural provinces. Examples from works such as "Nagi sad" by Wiesław Myśliwski, "Opowieści galicyjskie" by Andrzej Stasiuk, and "Prawiek i inne czasy" by Olga Tokarczuk allow tracing the evolution of the disappearance of cultural provinces and highlight the process of shaping degenerated post-peasant creations. The transition from peasantry through folk culture and new plebeianism to peripheral post-rurality, from uprooting through disinheritance to exile, accounts for the legacy of the past culture and portrays the peasant descendant as a person on the border of cultures and environments, becoming a new stranger in postmodern reality.

results.title: Semantic correlation and disambiguation of "Perun" in West and East Slavic languages and phraseology

abstracts.content: The aim of this paper is to investigate the stages of development of lexical item "Perun" (the late Proto-Slavic Thunder god) in Western and Eastern Slavic languages, dialects and phraseological units. This will be done considering how during a specific time, the theonym and the thunderstorm phenomenon associated with him have been inseparable and thus semantically correlated. Subsequently changes in the theonym, and in the use of the theonym, provoked changes in the common noun, resulting in semantic disambiguation. Often these changes brought a contrastive stance towards the theonym ("Perun" as a swear word or as an evil entity) but they also retained some positive meanings typical of previous cultural phases ("Perun" as a hero or a strong person). Western and Eastern Slavic languages and dialects show different pattern of semantic disambiguation and correlation, as the total disambiguation of Russian and Czech or the total correlation in Belarusian and Polish. The dialects and the phraseological material sums in general the contrastive attitude and the positive meaning of Perun, maintaining in some cases a certain degree of ambiguity.

This article discusses several legendary ways of writing about the history of medieval culture and the figure of the famous astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus. The author divided the legends into Enlightenment, Nazi, Communist and general ones. They are all simple but false ways of writing about history by contrast. They come from emotions and prejudices. In the source literature, there is no basis for the legendary image of Copernicus and his era.

results.title: Nowe specjalizacje w zawodzie bibliotekarza : data librarian, blended librarian, embedded librarian...

abstracts.content: The subject of the paper is the transformation of the librarian profession, especially the processes of shaping new specialisations and approaches to defining the role of librarians. The aim is to present competency profiles characteristic of contemporary varieties of the librarian profession, such as: data librarian, metadata librarian, linked data librarian, research librarian, blended librarian, embedded librarian, relational librarian and smart librarian. The method of analysis and criticism of the literature has been used. A systematic search was carried out in databases indexing journals with a high impact factor (IF) and a complementary search was conducted in order to find resources registered by the popular search engine of scientific resources Google Scholar. The collected material, including works published in 2013-2023, was then subjected to selection and qualitative analysis. As a result, conclusions have been formulated regarding the state of research on new specialisations within the librarian profession. Finally, the predictions concerning the further evolution of the profession have been made.

results.title: Rethinking hate speech and cyberhate concepts : the case of smear campaigns against judges in Poland

abstracts.content: The press and whistleblowers have reported that in Poland, not long ago (around 2018–2019), there was a special “taskforce”, headed by a senior officer in the Ministry of Justice, that was formed solely to spread defamatory comments about judges who disapproved of the new judicial reforms. Although certain legal proceedings (including cases initiated by the targeted judges themselves) are still pending, this set of circumstances nevertheless presents an excellent starting point for exploration of activities initiated and conducted by public officials in order to discredit a particular occupational group. This article aims at (a) providing a glimpse into the literature on hate speech and cyberhate, (b) outlining the general context of the conducted attacks, (c) identifying key features of the derogatory narrative presented in the @KastaWatch Twitter (now X) account and on the rightwing wPolityce.pl portal, (d) examining whether the speech acts comprising this narrative fit the schemes associated with the hate speech and cyberhate concepts, and (e) postulating lessons about democracies that can be derived from this particular case.

results.title: Transforming workspaces into sites of public history : former mineworkers as stakeholders and creators at museal institutions in Poland and England

abstracts.content: This study explores the transformation of post-industrial spaces into sites of public history, focusing on cultural museums situated on the sites of former coal mines in Wałbrzych, Poland, and Wakefield, England. These museums employ ex-miners as guides, mirroring similar practices observed at other European mining museums. This collaborative approach helps to address the negative social impacts of deindustrialization and actively shapes post-industrial spaces as centres of social interaction and public history. The study finds that this cooperative model holds potential for post-mining communities, as it allows them to reclaim agency in narrating their work histories. The success of this model in boosting community morale hinges on the existence of a symbiotic relationship between institutions, historians, cultural managers, and miner associations. These museums significantly contribute to national discussions on history, culture, tourism, and even climate. Although vernacular histories of mining work and workspaces may not always align with contemporary concerns, the adaptability of the museums and miner-guides fosters optimism about their role in shaping and producing engaging public histories within post-industrial spaces.

abstracts.content: Współczesna Służba Więzienna w Polsce identyfikuje się z historycznym dziedzictwem Straży Więziennej z okresu międzywojennego. Władze decydujące o kształcie polskiego więziennictwa w ostatnich latach często odwoływały się do tradycji systemu utworzonego po odzyskaniu niepodległości w 1918 r. Nowoczesne więziennictwo w pracach Zygmunta Bugajskiego i innych reformatorów z okresu międzywojennego to więziennictwo oparte na podstawach naukowych, dysponujące dobrze wyszkolonym personelem zmierzającym do poprawy skazanych przy poszanowaniu prawa i humanitarnym podejściu do nich. Program „Nowoczesne Więziennictwo” realizowany w Ministerstwie Sprawiedliwości kierowanym przez Zbigniewa Ziobrę istotnie różnił się od tamtej wizji nowoczesnego więziennictwa. Podstawowe różnice polegały na tym, że program „Nowoczesne Więziennictwo” nie opierał się na wiedzy naukowej, a na populistycznych strategiach przedstawicieli ministerstwa.

abstracts.content: This article examines female street names, known as gyneconyms. The text has a theoretical and material character. The first part consists of a consideration of the current situation and attempts to answer the question of why gynoconyms are few in urban space. The second part is a quantitative analysis of female street names in several Polish cities and a detailed presentation of the problem on the example of Krakow. The material was collected using the TERYT database and analyzed using statistical and linguistic methods. The urbanonymy of Krakow was divided by the method of thematic fields. The disproportion between male and female names turned out to be very visible, while numerous social initiatives give hope for its reduction.

abstracts.content: W artykule poddano analizie mało znany rękopis ze zbiorów Biblioteki Narodowej w Warszawie (BN 12432 III, 2 ćw. XVII w.), którego główną część stanowi kopia słowiańskiego (athoskiego) przekładu dwóch traktatów świętego Jana Damasceńskiego: Dialektyka albo rozdziały filozoficzne i Wykład szczegółowy wiary prawdziwej. Ciekawą część kodeksu stanowią teksty towarzyszące, które w pewnym stopniu pokazują losy księgi i miejsce jej powstania. Rękopis najprawdopodobniej został skopiowany na Wołoszczyźnie przez nieznanego mnicha z jakiegoś klasztoru z terenów Metropolii Kijowskiej. Zabytek stanowi ciekawy przykład kontaktów polskiego prawosławia w Rzeczypospolitej Obojga Narodów z tradycją literacką na Bałkanach.

The article analyzes a little-known manuscript from the collections of the National Library in Warsaw (BN 12432 III, 2nd quarter of the 17th century), the main part of which is a copy of the Slavic (Athos) translation of two works of Saint John of Damascus: Philosophical Chapters (Dialectic) and Exposition of the Orthodox faith. An interesting part of the codex are the accompanying texts, which to some extent show the fate of the book and the place of its creation. The manuscript was most likely copied in Wallachia by an unknown monk from some monastery in the Kiev Metropolis. The monument is an interesting example of contacts between Polish Orthodoxy in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and the literary tradition in the Balkans.

Autor utrzymuje przy tym, iż można  podkreślać niemożność tworzenia nauki poza społeczeństwem, ale nie musi to prowadzić bynajmniej do relatywizmu kulturowego, czy społecznego, a wprost przeciwnie jest to możliwe do pogodzenia z realizmem naukowym i prawdą rozumianą w sensie klasycznym. Pogląd taki broniony w kolejnych paragrafach poprzez odwołania do języka, praktyki naukowej oraz konieczności krytyki w nauce oraz wskazywanie w każdym przypadku na społeczno-kulturowy kontekst, w którym funkcjonują: bez społecznie rozwijanego języka koniecznego dla formułowanie naszych idei i ich wymiany, praktyki społecznej wdrażającej nas do badań naukowych i umożliwiających je oraz krytyki koniecznej dla rozwijania teorii naukowych, powstanie i rozwój nauki opisującej nasz świat byłyby niemożliwe.

The aim of this paper is to defend the view that social and cultural factors are indispensable for the development of science. The author maintains that it is possible to emphasise the impossibility of creating science outside society, but this does not necessarily lead to cultural or social relativism; on the contrary, it is possible to reconcile such a view with scientific realism and truth understood in the classical sense. This view is defended in the following paragraphs by referring to the language, scientific practice and the necessity of criticism in science, and by pointing in each case to the socio-cultural context in which they function. It is claimed that without the socially developed language necessary for the formulation of our ideas and their exchange, the social practice that introduces us to scientific research and enables it, and the criticism necessary for the development of scientific theories, the emergence and development of a science describing our world would be impossible.

results.title: Political system of the Polish-Lithuanian commonwealth and its legal bases : research dilemmas

abstracts.content:
Okres istnienia Rzeczypospolitej Obojga Narodów to niezwykle interesujące zagadnienie dla badaczy dziejów dawnego państwa polskiego.  Mogłoby się wydawać, że został on już dogłębnie zbadany. Jednak próba innego spojrzenia na kwestie ustrojowe powoduje potrzebę reinterpretacji źródeł. Wśród zagadnień wymagających ponownego naukowego namysłu można wskazać problem zasad elekcji władcy. Dotychczas była ona rozumiana na sposób współczesny. Oto szlachta zagwarantowała sobie, że po śmierci władcy, zjeżdża się na pole elekcyjne i wybiera jednego spośród zgłoszonych kandydatów. Czy tak rzeczywiście było, skoro elekcyjność tronu zagwarantował król w Artykułach henrykowskich wraz ze swoimi następcami królami polskimi, których należy kwalifikować jako jego potomków. A zatem szlachta miała wybierać spośród synów zmarłego monarchy. Dbałość o interes dynastii za panowania Zygmunta III Wazy skutkowała potrzebą doprecyzowania tego przepisu z punktu widzenia szlacheckich wyborców.
Kolejnym interesującym problemem było funkcjonowania najwyższego organu Rzeczypospolitej – sejmu walnego. Szczególną uwagę należy zwrócić na zagadnienia, które uważa się za przyczynę degrengolady tego organu ustawodawczego. Chodzi o instytucję liberum veto. Ten temat też się wydaje już zamknięty. Tymczasem jak funkcjonował ten mechanizm i czy rzeczywiście prawo posła do protestu rozumianego jako przejaw wolności słowa doprowadziło do fatalnych skutków dla polskiego parlamentaryzmu? Może do upadku doprowadziło przyzwolenie na opuszczanie miejsca obrad, choć sprzeciwiało się ono koncepcji deliberacji.
Te i inne problemy wymagają ponownej analizy w oparciu o bogate źródła archiwalne z tej epoki.

The period of existence of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is an extremely interesting issue for researchers of the history of the former Polish state. It would seem that it has already been thoroughly researched. However, an attempt to look at political issues differently results in the need to reinterpret archival sources. Among the issues that require renewed scientific consideration is the problem of the rules for electing the king. So far, it has been understood in a modern way. Here, the nobility guaranteed that after the ruler's death, they would go to the electoral field and choose one of the proposed candidates. Was this really the case, since the electability of the throne was guaranteed by the king in the Henrician Articles 1573 together with his successors, Polish kings, who should be qualified as his descendants. Therefore, the nobility had to choose from among the sons of the deceased monarch. Attention to the interests of the dynasty during the reign of Sigismund III Vasa resulted in the need to clarify this provision from the point of view of noble voters.
Another interesting problem was the functioning of the highest organ of the Republic of Poland - the General Sejm. Particular attention should be paid to issues that are believed to be the cause of the decline of this legislative body. This is about the institution of liberum veto. This topic also seems to be closed. Meanwhile, how did this mechanism function and did the MP's right to protest, understood as a manifestation of freedom of speech, actually lead to disastrous consequences for Polish parliamentarism? Perhaps what led to the downfall was the permission to leave the meeting place, even though it was contrary to the concept of deliberation.
These and other problems require re-analysis based on rich archival sources from this era.

abstracts.content: Rozwój tak zwanego Internetu Rzeczy (Internet-of-Things, urządzenia IoT) znacznie osłabił znaczenie tradycyjnie rozumianego prawa własności, które nie reguluje już samodzielnie korzystania z elektronicznych urządzeń. Przegrywa rywalizację z prawem autorskim, ochroną tajemnic przedsiębiorstwa, czy też z kontrolą nad usługami niezbędnymi do korzystania z urządzenia i nad danymi generowanymi przez nie, która może wynikać z umów lub mieć czysto faktyczny charakter. Nowo przyjęty Akt w sprawie danych odnosi się tylko jednej z tych kwestii, ułatwiając dostęp do danych generowanych przez urządzenia IoT oraz ich wykorzystywanie. Niniejszy tekst ocenia, w jaki sposób nowa regulacja wpłynie na równowagę interesów między właścicielami urządzeń IoT a ich producentami. Akt w sprawie danych przyznaje użytkownikom pewne prawa dostępu do danych generowanych przez ich urządzenia i usługi, które umożliwiają korzystanie z ich funkcji. Wymaga również uwzględnienia możliwości przenoszenia danych na etapie projektowania urządzeń IoT. Zakres regulacji został jednak celowo zawężony tylko do niektórych czynników ograniczających dostęp. W szczególności pominięto niemal wszystkie kwestie związane z prawami własności intelektualnej. Ze względu na ograniczenia co do kategorii danych, które mają zostać udostępnione, Akt w sprawie danych będzie miał wpływ tylko na niektóre relacje między nabywcami a producentami urządzeń. Co więcej, liczne uregulowania dotyczące zasad dostępu do danych dają producentom silniejszą pozycję. Dlatego nowa regulacja prawdopodobnie nie przechyli znacząco szali na korzyść nabywców urządzeń, a jednocześnie utrwali niektóre praktyki korzystne dla producentów. Z perspektywy zasady proporcjonalności, która wymaga zachowania sprawiedliwej równowagi między między kolidującymi interesami, Akt w sprawie danych nie wpływa na prawa producentów wystarczająco mocno.

The advent of the so-called Internet of Things or IoT devices significantly weakened the significance of traditional personal property rights, which are no longer the only rights that govern the use of devices. Instead, they are losing a tug of war against mechanisms such as copyright, trade secrets' statutory protection, contractual or even purely factual control over services necessary to use the device and, last but not least, over data generated by the use of devices. The newly adopted Data Act seeks to deal with only one of these issues by improving access to and the use of data generated by IoT devices. This chapter evaluates how the new regulation will affect the elusive balance of interests between the owners and manufacturers of such devices. The Data Act grants users certain rights to access data generated by their devices and by services that enable their functions. It also requires taking data portability into account at the stage of designing IoT devices. However, the scope of the regulation was intentionally narrowed to only some factors that limit the users' capabilities and specifically avoided almost all issues related to intellectual property rights. Due to limitations on the scope of categories of data to be made accessible, the Data Act will affect only some purchaser-manufacturer relationships. Moreover, numerous provisions concerning data access leave the manufacturers in a position of power. As a result, the new regulation will likely fail to tip the scales significantly in favour of device purchasers while entrenching some existing practices favourable to manufacturers. In this context, from the perspective of the principle of proportionality, which requires striking a fair balance between competing rights, the Data Act does not affect the manufacturers' rights strongly enough.

Russia became a particular subject of interest for Ryszard Kapuściński, a journalist of the Polish Press Agency, after the collapse of the Soviet Union, when newly independent countries appeared on the world map. Kapuściński shows the uniqueness of these countries from the socio-cultural perspective, not destroyed by several dozen years of Sovietization.

results.title: University as a collaborator : universities, society and culture

abstracts.content: This chapter discusses how Polish universities have changed the understanding of their role in the creation and dissemination of culture, as well as in the preservation of cultural heritage. The political transformation of 1989, which brought back democratic regime to Poland, was a turning point in Polish higher education system, and the government has started to understand its importance in securing economic growth and social stability. During the last decade of the 20th century and early 21st century, the government has introduced the market-centered approach to Polish higher education policy, partially following recommendations of the World Bank and OECD. However, the very recent changes show that universities should appreciate their social role that goes far beyond just economic impact. Therefore, Polish universities have once again adopted culture and cultural heritage as one of their key responsibilities.
